info.name: SAP S/4HANA Sales Order Sales Order Items API
info.description:
The SAP S/4HANA Sales Order API (API_SALES_ORDER_SRV) enables you to create, read, update, and delete sales orders in SAP S/4HANA.

Contact Support:
 Name: SAP API Support
